# Position Summary
The SAP Finance Consultant is responsible for leading complex SAP Finance solution design, configuration, and implementation activities across multiple functional domains, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, and Funds Management.
This individual is a recognized Subject Matter Expert, operating with minimal oversight, owning SAP Finance workstreams or key solution components, and serving as a trusted functional authority within project teams and with client stakeholders.
# Essential Functions & Responsibilities
- Designs and improves finance business processes through detailed system analysis, identifying risks, gaps, and optimization opportunities.
- Serves as the primary functional authority for assigned Finance scope, guiding solution decisions and resolving complex functional issues with multiple variables.
- Coordinates across solution architects, developers, BASIS, middleware, portal teams, and business analysts to deliver integrated SAP Finance solutions that meet functional, technical, and compliance requirements.

- Oversees maintenance, sustainment, and enhancement activities for SAP Finance modules, including evaluation of change requests, impact analysis, and recommendations for solution approaches.
# Minimum Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or related field and 5-7 years of relevant SAP Finance functional experience, including complex configuration and implementation responsibilities; or no degree and 7-10 years of relevant experience.
- Must be in the Columbus, Ohio area and willing to travel onsite to the location

- Proven ability to solve complex problems with multiple variables and to lead defined SAP Finance workstreams with minimal supervision.
- Strong experience coordinating across functional, technical, and architectural teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions.
- Experience leading complex testing efforts and stabilizing SAP Finance solutions through go‑live.

# About the Team
The Interplanetary Sciences Program is building a philanthropically funded Mars science orbiter targeted to launch in 2028.
You will build the integrated hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) test capability that allows the spacecraft team to test early, continuously, and with real hardware.
Then carry that ownership into final spacecraft integration and test leading up to flight.
This is a hands-on integration and test role spanning hardware, software automation, and spacecraft-level validation.
You will take the HITL environment from an empty rack to a running, automated, always-on validation system that proves our payloads, avionics, flight software, and interfaces work together as intended.
You will build the bench, the software fixturing that exercises flight software against real and representative hardware, and the CI and regression infrastructure that continuously checks the system as it evolves.
You won't just execute test procedures—you'll understand what each test proves, why it matters, and whether the result is actually credible.
You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineers across the spacecraft.
If you like owning a capability end to end, debugging across hardware and software boundaries, and being the reason the rest of the program can move quickly with confidence, this is that seat.
# About the Role
- Design, build, and maintain the ISP HITL test environment end to end, including rack fabrication, avionics installation, breakout hardware, load emulation, harness fabrication and routing, and supporting test equipment.
- Build the simulation, data-acquisition, and control infrastructure that drives stimulus into the system, captures results, and allows flight software to be exercised against real and representative spacecraft hardware.
- Develop software fixturing, automated test frameworks, and CI/regression pipelines that validate every software change on hardware with automated pass/fail adjudication, regression detection, and clear failure reporting.
- Debug integrated failures across flight software, avionics, interfaces, harnessing, timing, communications, and test infrastructure until root cause is understood and fed back to the responsible design teams.
- Validate timing-sensitive behavior and interfaces across sensors, actuators, payloads, avionics, and communication buses, including longer-duration and soak testing where appropriate.
- Establish dashboards, telemetry views, configuration control, and test procedures that make system health, test coverage, anomalies, and requirements traceability clear to the broader engineering team.
- Drive final integration and test of flight hardware leading into launch, coordinating with subsystem responsible engineers to ensure hardware and software are designed for integration and test from the beginning.
# About You
- Degree in computer, electrical, aerospace, or a related engineering field, or equivalent hands-on experience
- 7+ years of experience in test engineering, including architecting automated test frameworks for integrated hardware, firmware, and software systems
- Strong, current software skills for test automation, tooling, and validation pipelines
- A track record of building test automation and CI/regression infrastructure from the ground up, including telemetry/logging, automated pass/fail, and continuous test execution
- Hands-on hardware and embedded systems experience, including bench troubleshooting with standard electronics equipment and familiarity with interfaces such as Ethernet, UART, and SPI
- Demonstrated ability to own a complex test capability end to end, drive integrated hardware/software failures to root cause, and coordinate effectively across engineering teams
# Nice to haves but not required
- Experience standing up a test bench, HITL system, SIL/HIL environment, lab automation capability, or integrated test platform from scratch
- Experience with spacecraft, launch vehicles, satellites, robotics, autonomous systems, aircraft, vehicles, medical devices, industrial equipment, or other high-reliability hardware
- Hands-on experience with harnessing, cable fabrication, breakout boards, rack wiring, or test equipment setup
- Experience helping establish test practices, tools, or team processes in a fast-moving engineering environment

Title: Technical Account Manager
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

ICON is seeking a Technical Account Manager to support adoption and implementation of ICON’s technology for markets within the state of Texas.
This role will build relationships with in-market building officials, engineers, and inspectors that drive regulatory acceptance, adoption, and market expansion of ICON's construction technology in the private sector.
Reporting to the Director of Building Regulatory Affairs and working closely with ICON’s customer-facing teams, this role is the technically fluent representative of ICON to local building departments and design professionals, focused on supporting ICON’s customers.
This is a relationship- and market-development role with a working technical foundation, not a deep engineering role.
This role is based our of our Headquarters in Austin, TX.
# RESPONSIBILITIES
- Sustain regulatory acceptance and go-to-market standing across the established markets in the assigned market area, keeping approvals current and jurisdictional requirements met as active projects proceed.
- Open new markets within the assigned area by mapping acceptance and approval pathways and jurisdictional requirements in advance of active projects, surfacing AHJ-specific risks early enough to inform market-selection and go-to-market decisions.
- Provide support to customers and sales teams to gain the regulatory and permitting approvals necessary to build with ICON’s technology across the private residential, commercial, and industrial construction sectors.
- Build, own, and maintain the building official, regulatory, and market design-professional relationships that facilitate technology acceptance and accelerate market adoption, including travel regularly throughout the assigned state and market and to Austin, TX headquarters.
- Deliver presentations and educational technical materials to customers, building officials, plan reviewers, design professionals, and industry stakeholders to promote awareness and adoption of ICON's technology and its regulatory pathways.
- Provide technical sales support to ICON’s Sales and Business Development teams throughout the sales cycle, such as customer presentations, technical sales calls, and proposal input, positioning ICON's technology and regulatory readiness.
- Engage with customer-facing teams early in the sales pipeline to assess proposed project scope and jurisdiction, surface regulatory and permitting considerations before commitments are made, and shape the approach to smooth the path through acceptance, permitting, and construction.
- Serve as the first-line building regulatory contact and support for customers, local jurisdictions, and project teams, answering routine code and product questions, drawing on the appropriate ICON subject matter experts for technical depth, and escalating complex building regulatory approval challenges to the Director.
- Track and stay up-to-date on regional code and approval considerations across jurisdictions in the market and share regular updates with stakeholders to inform market expansion and product strategy.
- Provide regular updates to stakeholders and department leadership on adoption progress, relationships, emerging risks, and blockers in assigned markets.
- Provide feedback to ICON’s technology teams on product and services opportunities to improve adoption and ease regulatory approvals.
- Remain current and up-to-date with ICON’s product and service offerings within the market and effectively represent them to customers and building officials.
# MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree in construction management, business, marketing, engineering, architecture, communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
- 6+ years in client-facing roles in construction, building products, or AEC, such as technical sales, business development, market development, customer-facing technical support, or a design/engineering role with direct client and project-team responsibility, with the technical aptitude to learn and represent complex product performance and the relationship command to build and grow customer accounts.
- Demonstrated success opening markets and building relationships with customers and external stakeholders
- Working familiarity with building codes and the local approval process (e.g., IBC, IRC, AHJ plan review) sufficient to speak credibly with building officials and design professionals and to answer routine questions
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with proven public speaking skills across diverse audiences including customers, regulatory officials, design professionals, and internal stakeholders.
- Exceptional relationship-building and networking abilities with demonstrated success establishing trust and credibility with external stakeholders in professional and regulatory environments or similar.
- Self-motivated and highly organized with ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, prioritize competing demands, and adapt to evolving project scopes and requirements.
- Willingness to travel regularly throughout the assigned state and market and to Austin, TX headquarters.
- Valid driver's license and ability to operate a motor vehicle for site visits and meetings.
# PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
- Direct experience in technical sales or business development of building products, construction systems, or other engineered/technical products, with a track record of owning the customer relationship from technical evaluation through close.
- Bachelor's degree in Structural Engineering, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Architectural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Experience selling or promoting a technical or building product to AHJs, building officials, or design professionals
- Established relationships with building departments, code officials, or design professionals in the target market)
- Familiarity with 3D printing, additive manufacturing, or advanced construction methods
- A construction, building-technology, or design background providing a stronger technical foundation
- Deep experience with building codes and standards (IBC, IRC, ACI, ASCE)
- Experience in design-build, fast-track, or integrated project delivery environments

# Senior Product Manager, PLG & Onboarding
# About the role
Exclaimer is the leading email signature management vendor.
Our product appeals to companies who need their employees’ emails to include disclaimers and signatures with consistent branding.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our product-led growth (PLG) motion, with a particular focus on the self-serve onboarding flow on www.exclaimer.com: the path a new user takes from signup through activation, to their first meaningful "aha" moment during a trial, to becoming a paying customer.
You’ll be working closely with our Head of PLG, with whom you agree improvements to the onboarding flow.
Your impact on activation and time-to-value translates directly into revenue, retention, and lower cost of acquisition.
You'll sit at the intersection of product, design, data, growth marketing, and sales, and you'll be judged on outcomes - activation rate, time-to-value, self-serve conversion, trial-to-paid - not just features shipped.
# What you’ll do
- Own the self-serve funnel end to end – the initial focus is on signup, activation and first-value.
- Redesign and continuously improve onboarding – make it really easy for new users to set up and deploy their first signature in an intuitive self-guided way that gets users to value fast.
- Track funnel metrics activation rate, time-to-value, trial/free-to-paid conversion - and set targets against them. Partner with data to improve on analytics.
- Run a disciplined experimentation program prioritise, design, ship, and analyse A/B tests across the onboarding and activation funnel.
- Write specs and prioritise the roadmap for PLG and onboarding initiatives, balancing quick wins against structural changes.
- Partner with growth marketing on the handoff from acquisition to product landing pages, signup flow, lifecycle email/in-app messaging.
- Partner with sales and customer success on clean handoffs for accounts that need a human touch.
- Contribute to pricing and packaging – the structure of our packages, feature gating, paywalls, and upgrade triggers.
- Talk to users constantly usability testing, interviews, session replay, and support/NPS signal - to find where self-serve users get stuck.
- Report on PLG health to leadership, translating funnel data into a clear narrative and a prioritised action plan.
# What you'll bring
Experience
- You are an experienced product manager, who has owned and improved a PLG motion or self-serve onboarding/activation funnel at a B2B SaaS company.
- A track record of moving a specific metric activation rate, time-to-value, trial-to-paid conversion - and can speak to the before/after in detail.
- Experience running structured experimentation at a meaningful cadence, not one-off tests.
- Experience working cross-functionally with design, engineering, data, marketing, and sales/CS.
Skills & ways of working
- Data fluency – comfortable using data tools (Tableau, Databricks, Heap), with an inquisitive mind, drawing sound conclusions and making data-informed decisions.
- Product craft strong UX instincts and a close working relationship with design; can review a Figma flow and know what will confuse or delight a new user.
- Systems thinking sees the funnel as an integral part of the overall product and customer experience.
- Commercial acumen understands how pricing, packaging, and monetisation levers interact with activation and conversion.
- Technical fluency and AI can talk credibly with engineers about implementation trade-offs without needing to write the code. Is able to build AI into their workflows and to continuously seek ways to improve velocity and quality.
- Communication writes clearly, prioritises ruthlessly, and can bring stakeholders along with objective arguments and a clear point of view.
- Collaboration and continuous learning – works well with geographically dispersed colleagues from a range of disciplines to achieve a common goal. Helps others improve their game by giving constructive feedback. Believes in continuous learning.
